extraction_notes: US1DW uses the solid 'US1AW-US1DW' curve in Fig.3, per the figure legend. Fig.4's temperature curves are drawn once for the whole family.
Curves digitized from a 400 dpi raster; estimated read error about +/-0.01 V (Fig.3) and +/-10 percent of value (Fig.4).
Fig.4 x-axis preserved as printed: percent of rated peak reverse voltage; 100 percent corresponds to VRRM = 200 V for US1DW. Both Fig.4 curves rise steeply near 125-130 percent of rated voltage.
High-temperature table leakage, not to be fitted as 25 degC data: IR = 200 uA max at VR = VDC, Ta = 125 degC (p. 2).
No breakdown row exists; VRRM = 200 V (p. 1) is an absolute maximum rating, not a measured breakdown, so breakdown fields are null.
In forward_voltage_points the current entry is the exact specified test condition (source_kind 'typical'); the voltage entry is a datasheet maximum.
The job manifest left manufacturer blank; 'hongjiacheng' is taken from the datasheet footer 'Zhuhai Hongjiacheng Technology co., Ltd' (www.ichjc.com), the same vendor as the rest of this batch.
Additional ratings on p. 1 (US1DW column): VRRM = 200 V, VRMS = 140 V, VDC = 200 V, IF(AV) = 1.0 A, IFSM = 30 A @ 8.3 ms half-sine, RthJA = 85 degC/W, RthJL = 30 degC/W.
